content.title: -ed 分词作状语速查
content.intro: 过去分词(-ed)作状语,逻辑主语就是主句主语;当主语是动作的承受者(被动)时用 -ed,可表原因、时间或条件。判断口诀:主语'被怎么样'→ 用 -ed;主语'主动做'→ 用 -ing。

rows: Disappointed by his behaviour, I told my friend. = Because I was disappointed …
Seen from afar, the statue looks alive. = When it is seen from afar …
Given more time, we could solve it. = If we were given more time …
Worried about her, Joy helped.(被动→-ed) / Believing she is right, Joy leads.(主动→-ing)

specialRules.rule: 逻辑主语=主句主语,且主语是动作承受者(被动)→ 用过去分词 -ed
specialRules.mark: Treated this way, you feel hurt(you 被这样对待)

specialRules.rule: 主语是动作发出者(主动)→ 用现在分词 -ing
specialRules.mark: Filled with anger, he spoke without thinking 对比 Smiling kindly, she helped me

specialRules.rule: 情感类动词:人'被…'的感受用 -ed(interested/worried),'令人…'的性质用 -ing(interesting/worrying)
specialRules.mark: I was interested. / The book is interesting.

specialRules.rule: -ed 分词状语常可还原为 because / when / if 引导的状语从句
specialRules.mark: Approached in this way = If it is approached in this way

why: 过去分词本身含被动、完成意味;作状语时它紧扣主句主语,只要主语是这个动作的'承受方',就用 -ed,而无需写出完整的被动从句,句子更简洁地道。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空/短文改错高频:给动词,据逻辑主语判断填 -ed(被动)还是 -ing(主动)。
句首独立的 -ed/-ing 状语,务必核对它的逻辑主语与主句主语一致(避免'垂悬分词')。

examVsReal.exam: Disappointed by his behaviour, I told my friend everything.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: I was so disappointed by what he did that I told my friend everything.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考分词状语的简洁形式;日常口语常直接用从句或并列句,更自然。

examVsReal.exam: Given more time, we could finish it.(考试)
examVsReal.real: If we had more time, we could finish it.
examVsReal.note: 考试用 -ed 分词表条件;口语里直接说 if 从句更常见。
